lines.en: Rumble... Watch out for my shots!

lines.zh: 咕噜……我的子弹能追踪你！
嘶嘶嘶……尝尝我的毒液吧！

lines.en: Rumble... You'll curse the day you came!
My roots creep forward inch by inch.
I drag my vines through the cracks.
My leaves rustle as I close in.
Rumble... Waiting for you to get close.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶……这里是我的领地。

lines.en: Sss... My venom has no cure.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……我的子弹会把你吞没。
lines.en: Sss... My shots will consume you.

lines.zh: 咕噜……你触碰了不该触碰的东西。
lines.en: Rumble... You've touched something you shouldn't.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……我的子弹不会撒谎。
lines.en: Sss... My shots always find you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶……你逃不出我的手掌。
lines.en: Sss... You can't escape my grasp.

lines.zh: 咕噜……我的子弹会把你击倒。
lines.en: Rumble... My shots will bring you down.

lines.zh: 咕噜……我的子弹不会空发。
你被绿色的子弹吸引了，小心曼陀罗的追踪弹！
lines.en: Green bullets attract you; beware Mandragora's跟踪弹！

lines.zh: 别靠近，小心曼陀罗的绿色子弹！
lines.en: Stay away; Mandragora's green bullets are dangerous！

lines.zh: 曼陀罗的根茎在诱惑你，但子弹很致命！
lines.en: Mandragora's roots tempt you, but the bullets are deadly！

lines.zh: 靠近曼陀罗，你会被绿色子弹击中！
lines.en: Get close to Mandragora, and get hit by green bullets！

lines.zh: 别被曼陀罗的美丽外表迷惑！子弹追踪你！
lines.en: Don't be fooled by Mandragora's beauty; bullets track you！

lines.zh: 绿色子弹来自曼陀罗的嘴！远离它们！
lines.en: Green bullets from Mandragora's mouth! Stay away！

lines.zh: 曼陀罗的根茎散发毒气，子弹追踪你！
lines.en: Mandragora's roots release poison; bullets track you！

lines.zh: 小心！曼陀罗的子弹会击中你！
别试图捡起曼陀罗掉落的东西！
曼陀罗的子弹有毒，小心被击中！
你撞上了曼陀罗的根茎！
曼陀罗的根茎缠住了你！
你撞上了曼陀罗的躯干！
曼陀罗的子弹击中你了！
你被曼陀罗的根茎绊倒了！
曼陀罗的根茎缠绕住了你！
曼陀罗的子弹穿透了你！
你撞上了曼陀罗的身体！
曼陀罗的根茎绊住了你！
曼陀罗的同类向你靠近！
曼陀罗的同类要繁殖了！
小心！曼陀罗的同类要攻击你！
曼陀罗的同类正在追踪你！
曼陀罗的同类要交配了！
曼陀罗的同类向你发起了攻击！
曼陀罗的同类要繁殖后代！
小心！曼陀罗的同类要攻击！
曼陀罗的同类要进行交配！
曼陀罗的同类正在逼近！
我体内寄生的种子渴望自由！
把我的种子种在泥土里！
lines.en: Plant my seeds in the soil!

lines.zh: 黑暗中我的种子在游荡！

lines.en: I am the seed of death!

lines.zh: 在梦魇中寻找我的种子！
lines.en: Seek my seeds in the nightmare!

lines.zh: 我的种子会侵蚀你的灵魂！

lines.en: My fruit torments you in dreams!
Green seeds are already flying at you.

lines.zh: 你的存在激发了我的种子！
我的种子渴望你的鲜血！
我的种子在你体内苏醒！
我的子弹不会轻易放弃！

lines.en: A pair of eyes opens among the leaves.
I heard you snap a dead branch.
The air has changed its smell.
A door on the second layer opened.
I have waited long for this.

lines.zh: 你的命是我的种子的养料！
瞄准你的心脏，我的种子！

lines.en: Feel the power of the seed of death!
My seeds will tear you apart!
Feel the malice of my seeds!

lines.zh: 我的子弹将你撕成碎片！
lines.en: My bullets tear you to pieces!
A green orb swells in my mouth.
The bullet will find you on its own.
I count the steps you have left.
I aim my bud at your chest.
I wait for the bullet to round your back.
I gather strength in the dark.
My leaves part and show teeth.
Venom runs down through my roots.
You step back, I step forward.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，它那扭曲的面孔对着你笑！
lines.en: Sssss, its twisted face grins at you.

lines.zh: 毒舌舔过你的皮肤，剧痛难忍！
lines.en: Its toxic tongue burns your skin.

lines.zh: 它的长牙对着你咧开嘴！
lines.en: Its long fangs grin at you.

lines.zh: 绿色的子弹如影随形，无法躲避！
lines.en: Green bullets follow you, nowhere to hide.
Bite you, poison takes effect instantly.

lines.zh: 它那嘶嘶的声音在耳边回响！
lines.en: Its sibilant hiss in your ears.

lines.zh: 毒素顺着伤口进入你的身体！
lines.en: Poison enters your body through the wound.

lines.zh: 它的毒牙在你的肉上留下印记！
lines.en: Its venomous fangs leave marks on your flesh.

lines.zh: 绿色液体从伤口流出，剧痛难忍！
lines.en: Green fluid oozes from the wound, pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 它那邪恶的眼睛盯着你！
lines.en: Its evil eyes fixate on you.

lines.zh: 绿弹擦着你的耳朵飞过
lines.en: A green bolt grazes your ear.
The bullet bends to chase you.
A spray of venom hits your face.
My fangs bite through your sleeve.
My bud bursts in a spray of green.

lines.zh: 毒茄参的根须甩向你的脸。
lines.en: My mandrake roots whip at your face.
The second shot is already away.
The venom burns under your skin.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它从深渊中浮现！
lines.en: It emerges from the depths at night.

lines.zh: 噩梦之地第二层，它的家！
lines.en: Its home in the second layer of Nightmare.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在黑暗的洞穴中！
绿色的光点指引你靠近它！
lines.en: Green light draws you to it.
Find it in the eyes of the nightmare.

lines.zh: 它的身影在黑暗中若隐若现！
lines.en: Its shadow flickers in the darkness.
It moves slowly in the shadows.

lines.zh: 夜风中传来它的嘶嘶声！
lines.en: Its sibilant hiss in the night wind.
It emerges slowly from the darkness.

lines.zh: 阴影中有一团绿色的蠕动！
lines.en: A green mass writhes in the shadows.
A small mound swells in the dirt.
The second layer grows another one.

lines.zh: 绿色触手剥夺我的力量...
绿色触手将我拉入虚无...
lines.en: Green tendrils drag me into void...
